M07 Hardening, round 1: **PASS**, after one small fix that I made myself. Every check passed on the real stack.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Code review (`git diff HEAD` + untracked files) | T089–T100 are all really in the code; contract untouched; no constitution breaches |
| Swagger vs contract | Pass, all 35 operations match |
| `./mvnw verify` | 188 tests, 0 failures |
| curl regression on a fresh database | 73/73 across 7 suites (M07: 5/5) |
| E2E-M07-01 full journey | Pass on the real clock: the start banner showed once, rest time counted down, and the plan reached 100% and moved to History. No console errors, no 5xx. |
| E2E-M07-03 backend down | Pass: all 6 pages show an error box with a Retry button. After restarting the backend, Retry reloaded the data on Settings and on Tasks; I did not retest recovery on the other four pages. |
| E2E-M07-04 keyboard | Pass after the fix: focus stays inside dialogs, and Escape returns it to the button that opened them |
| Smoke E2E-M01-01 … E2E-M06-01 | All pass, in order; empty states on the fresh database also pass |
| `npx ng build` | Passes with no warnings |

**Fix F1** (`frontend/src/styles.scss`, +6 lines): Angular Material buttons switch off the browser's focus outline. With only the keyboard, a focused button showed just a faint tint, which fails T096's "visible focus outlines". I added a 2px focus ring for these buttons and re-ran the keyboard check and the build.

There are no FIX tasks and no contract issues. Non-blocking notes in the report:
- **Settings save risk:** if Settings fails to load, the form still shows default values and Save stays enabled. Clicking Save then would overwrite the stored settings with those defaults.
- **Unticked plan items:** a new plan's items start unticked even when the task, habit or card is already done. That matches business rule 13 but may surprise users.

The report is `loops/verify/outputs/M07-round-1.md`, with browser details in `evidence/M07/round-1/e2e-result.md`. I also appended to `progress.md` and rewrote `handoff.md`, and wrote `verdict.json` last. The screenshots stayed in `run-artifacts/playwright/` (named `verify-M07-r1-*`) because copying them into the evidence folder isn't allowed in this session. Nothing was committed; the backend (:8090) and frontend (:4300) are still running for the runner to stop.
